name: Boeing B-17G Flying Fortress (Blender model)
blurb: An original B-17G built in Blender from cited dimensions and a measured three-view, kept beside the downloaded Flying Fortress for comparison. Its gear, four propellers, controls, six defensive gun groups, and bomb-bay doors move. Not flown yet.
history:
The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress was the United States Army Air Forces' best-known four-engine heavy bomber in Europe. The late B-17G added the Bendix chin turret to an already formidable defensive armament.

What this entry models: an original Blender B-17G (span 103 ft 9 in, length 74 ft 4 in, thirteen .50-caliber guns) measured against Kaboldy's corrected Wikimedia Commons three-view. The flying B-17 still draws the downloaded model.
